facts.text: The complex interaction of orbits and rotations between Yag'Dhul and its three moons meant that the planet was continually beset by massive tidal forces powerful enough to pull the atmosphere into different regions, exposing large areas of the surface to hard vacuum.

evidence.quote: The complex interaction of orbits and rotations between Yag'Dhul and its three moons meant that the planet was continually beset by massive tidal forces powerful enough to pull the atmosphere into different regions, exposing large areas of the surface to hard vacuum.

facts.text: The desire to maximize advantages had led the Givin to switch alliances as variables changed, such as when they had allied themselves with the Separatists during the Clone Wars era and later with the New Republic.

facts.text: Orbiting a yellow star, Yag'Dhul was a small but dense planet.

evidence.quote: Orbiting a yellow star, Yag'Dhul was a small but dense planet.

facts.text: A gray cloud cover made the world appear dull and colorless.

evidence.quote: A gray cloud cover made the world appear dull and colorless.

facts.text: The planet possessed three large moons that orbited one another around a common center of gravity.

evidence.quote: The planet possessed three large moons that orbited one another around a common center of gravity.

facts.text: At the same time, the moons and Yag'Dhul itself orbited a second shared center of gravity, as their combined mass amounted to roughly 70 percent of the planet's mass.

evidence.quote: At the same time, the moons and Yag'Dhul itself orbited a second shared center of gravity, as their combined mass amounted to roughly 70 percent of the planet's mass.

facts.text: This complex gravitational arrangement caused each moon and the planet to influence the motion of the others, creating a system that appeared highly erratic.

evidence.quote: This complex gravitational arrangement caused each moon and the planet to influence the motion of the others, creating a system that appeared highly erratic.

facts.text: The presence of these three moons, together with a low-frequency retrograde rotation, resulted in some of the most severe tidal effects known in the galaxy.

evidence.quote: The presence of these three moons, together with a low-frequency retrograde rotation, resulted in some of the most severe tidal effects known in the galaxy.

facts.text: Yag'Dhul had a retrograde rotation with a period of 175 standard hours, meaning it spun opposite to the direction of the moons' orbit.

evidence.quote: Yag'Dhul had a retrograde rotation with a period of 175 standard hours, meaning it spun opposite to the direction of the moons' orbit.

facts.text: Yag'Dhul and its moons completed their mutual orbital cycle in only 53 standard hours, resulting in a difference of 122 hours between the planet's rotational period and orbital cycle.

evidence.quote: Yag'Dhul and its moons completed their mutual orbital cycle in only 53 standard hours, resulting in a difference of 122 hours between the planet's rotational period and orbital cycle.

facts.text: As a result, Yag'Dhul's oceans and even its atmosphere flowed from one side of the planet to the other in patterns predictable only through the application of advanced mathematics.

evidence.quote: As a result, Yag'Dhul's oceans and even its atmosphere flowed from one side of the planet to the other in patterns predictable only through the application of advanced mathematics.

facts.text: As the atmosphere shifted, it boiled and swirled violently, generating powerful storms that filled the gray skies with lightning and illuminated flashes of red stone visible even from orbit.

evidence.quote: As the atmosphere shifted, it boiled and swirled violently, generating powerful storms that filled the gray skies with lightning and illuminated flashes of red stone visible even from orbit.

facts.text: At certain times of the year, the same three moons that wreaked havoc on Yag'Dhul's surface created especially perilous tidal conditions that extended the time required for ships to revert from hyperspace and navigate to new coordinates before returning to lightspeed.

evidence.quote: At certain times of the year, the same three moons that wreaked havoc on Yag'Dhul's surface created especially perilous tidal conditions that extended the time required for ships to revert from hyperspace and navigate to new coordinates before returning to lightspeed.
